mapper.select: select id, tournament_id, season_id, old_announcement_id, new_announcement_id, rule_version, effective_time, invalid_time, current_flag, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_announcement_rule_link where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0

select id, tournament_id, season_id, old_announcement_id, new_announcement_id, rule_version, effective_time, invalid_time, current_flag, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_announcement_rule_link where season_id = #{seasonId} and current_flag = 1 and is_delete = 0 limit 1

select id, tournament_id, season_id, old_announcement_id, new_announcement_id, rule_version, effective_time, invalid_time, current_flag, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_announcement_rule_link where new_announcement_id = #{newAnnouncementId} and current_flag = 0 and is_delete = 0 order by id desc limit 1
